case_title.quote: SHYAMAL GHOSH v. STATE OF WEST BENGAL
case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment heading.

number_of_accused.quote: Eight accused, namely, Panchanan Tarafdar@ Chotka, Uttam Das, ... were charged
number_of_accused.reason: Eight accused were charged and their liability decided; four is only the number of appellants in this appeal.

accused_gender.quote: Accused Ganesh, in his statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C., admitted the fact that he was absconding
accused_gender.reason: Accused are male, referred to with male pronouns and names.

accused_age.reason: No accused age is stated in the judgment.

accused_religion.reason: No religious identity of the accused is described.

accused_caste.reason: No caste or community of the accused is named.

accused_occupation.reason: Occupations are given for witnesses and the victim, not for the accused.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Poverty is attributed to witnesses, not to the accused.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.quote: the victim Archideb Bhattacharjee had started from his house on his Avon bicycle

victim_caste.reason: No caste of the victim is named.

victim_religion.reason: No religion of the victim is stated.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: the accused persons had demanded Rs.40,000/- from Archideb Bhattarcharjee towards 'Tola Mastani Salami'
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Extortion demand and threats over shop rooms describe a prior dispute; no family tie is stated.

offence_category.quote: charged with offences under Sections 302, 201, 379, 411 read with Section 34
offence_category.reason: Main offence is murder under s.302.

statutory_provisions.quote: charged with offences under Sections 302, 201, 379, 411 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860
statutory_provisions.reason: Sections match the charge as stated.

weapon.quote: recovered the chopper ... admitted that they had cut the body of the deceased with the chopper; gumcha used in strangulation
weapon.reason: Chopper and gumcha are both supported by the judgment.

evidence_type.quote: These are the recoveries of the weapon of offence as well as the vehicle
evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness, circumstantial, recovery, medical and documentary evidence are all discussed.

confession.correct_value: Admission by accused Bishu, made during recovery of the chopper and recorded in PW-2's evidence; not expressly analysed as a confession.
confession.quote: the chopper which was recovered on the statement of accused Bishu ... admitted that they had cut the body
confession.reason: Admission and recovery are supported, but the judgment never says the Court disregarded the admission as a confession.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: Absconding in such a manner and for such a long period is a relevant consideration.
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Absconding, threats and dismemberment are noted as aggravating facts in the judgment.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating facts are noted in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.quote: Trial Court awarded sentence of death to all the accused persons for the offence under Section 302 IPC
trial_court_outcome.reason: Conviction on all charges, death sentence, and s.201 and s.379 sentences match.

high_court_outcome.quote: answering the death reference in the negative, acquitted all the accused persons of the offence under Section 379 read with Section 34 IPC
high_court_outcome.reason: Death reference, s.379 acquittal, life sentence and s.201 sentence all match.

offence_finally_established.quote: maintained their conviction except u/s.379/34 IPC
offence_finally_established.reason: Murder and s.201 convictions stand; s.379 acquittal is supported.

imprisonment_type.quote: awarded R1 for life and fine of Rs. 5000/-
imprisonment_type.reason: Final sentence for s.302/34 is life imprisonment.

imprisonment_years.reason: Not a fixed-term sentence, so null is correct.

fine_rs.quote: awarded them rigorous imprisonment for life and to pay a fine of Rs.5,000/- each
fine_rs.reason: Fine of Rs.5,000 for the s.302 conviction is supported.

neutral_facts.reason: Summary describes incident and evidence without naming parties or revealing outcome; no court proceedings mentioned.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the statutory punishment range.

attempt_completion.quote: he was murdered by them on the midnight of 29th/30th September, 2003

physical_harm.quote: The cause of death was due to effect of strangulation by ligature
physical_harm.reason: Death by ligature strangulation and dismemberment is supported.

number_of_offences.quote: charged with offences under Sections 302, 201, 379, 411 read with Section 34
number_of_offences.reason: Four sections charged; s.302 and s.201 upheld; s.379 acquitted; s.411 not addressed.

financial_property_loss.quote: according to PW4 the deceased was wearing four rings, HMT watch and was carrying cash
financial_property_loss.reason: Cash and jewellery are supported; extortion demand of Rs.40,000 also noted.

premeditation_planning.quote: all these acts obviously were in furtherance to the common intention of doing away with the deceased
premeditation_planning.reason: Common intention to kill if money not paid is found; no separate premeditation finding.

motive.quote: statements of all these witnesses clearly show one motive, i.e., illegal demand of money
motive.reason: Demand of money with threats is the motive the Court accepted.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: The statements of PWs 8, 17, 19, 7, 9 and 11 completely establish
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Eyewitness, post-mortem, recovery and last-seen evidence relied on are accurately listed.

witness_credibility.quote: Their statements are reliable and trustworthy.
witness_credibility.reason: Eyewitnesses, related witnesses and hostile witnesses are assessed as described.

post_offence_conduct.quote: Accused Ganesh ... admitted the fact that he was absconding even till the charge-sheet was filed
post_offence_conduct.reason: Absconding, arrests from Delhi and Sodhpur, and surrender are supported.

bail_history.reason: Bail is not mentioned in the judgment.

trial_duration.quote: Trial Court vide its judgment dated 13th September, 2005
trial_duration.reason: Offence, trial, High Court and Supreme Court dates are all supported.

legal_representation.quote: Pradip Ghosh, J.K. Das, Yadunandan Bansal, ... for the appearing parties
legal_representation.reason: Counsel are listed collectively without separation, as the value states.

investigation_status.quote: Charge sheet against all other six accused was filed.
investigation_status.reason: FIR, investigation, charge sheet and later arrests are supported.

procedural_irregularity.quote: the Investigating Officer failed to send the blood stained gunny bags and other recovered weapons to the FSL
procedural_irregularity.reason: Investigation lapses and delays in recording statements are noted by the Court.

appeal_history.quote: The High Court ... while answering the death reference in the negative
appeal_history.reason: Trial, High Court and Supreme Court outcomes are accurately summarised.

prosecution_argument.quote: According to the learned counsel, defective investigation normally would not prove fatal
prosecution_argument.reason: Motive, eyewitnesses, absconding and s.34 arguments are accurately summarised.

defence_argument.quote: PW17, Amal Ray is a tutored witness ... PW8, Binode Mallick and PW19, Kali Das cannot be believed as they are chance witnesses
defence_argument.reason: Defence arguments on hostile witnesses, tutoring, chance witnesses and s.34 are supported.

legal_principle_applied.quote: Once the last seen theory comes into play, the onus was on the accused
legal_principle_applied.reason: Principles applied by the Court are accurately listed.

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Govindaraju@ Govinda v. State by Sriramapuram P.S. (2012) 4 SCC 122 - relied on
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Main precedents and citations match the judgment; minor spelling variant only.

sentencing_rationale.quote: we see no reason to interfere with the judgment of the High Court either on merits or on the quantum of sentence
sentencing_rationale.reason: No separate sentencing reasoning; the Court simply declined to interfere.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: The Court weighed no mitigating factors for sentence.

judicial_aggravating_factors.quote: Absconding in such a manner and for such a long period is a relevant consideration.
judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Absconding was weighed as evidence of guilt, not as a sentencing aggravator; the Court weighed no aggravating factors for sentence.

other_sentence_order.reason: No compensation, directions or other orders are made.
